sections.title: Botanical library route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the botanical library. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the garden gate. From there, walk towards the glasshouse. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the reference room.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the gravel beds today. The gardeners have left their tools there. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
